articles.deck: Residents of Foundry Row filled the hall on Wednesday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Public works estimates the work will take about 24 weeks once it begins. The group has raised $25,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.

articles.title: Wanda Vasquez, 95, Parish Bookkeeper
articles.deck: Friends remember Wanda Vasquez for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Wanda Vasquez died in March at home on Mulberry Avenue, at the age of 95. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program in his or her name.

Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood. Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Wanda Vasquez spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
